Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/45966, close #31778 

Problem Summary:

The previous GCStats will read nearly all the stats into the memory

### What is changed and how it works?

This pull tries to limit its influence.

issue_context.title: Huge memory pulse in non foreground workload cluster
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
![image](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/7846227/1c2b4c09-2c14-4168-9583-cbbf9ed8c0be)
We can observe memory pulse periodically.

It's possible that the statistics' async GC causes this.
The following profile is the CPU profile when the memory goes high.
![45bbca2f-f52c-4960-a04f-ee5a23124cf2](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/7846227/9defbb1e-80c1-4195-a88e-f36515099e46)


![526e4399-c798-4102-a3ba-6aec34d31d08](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/7846227/a56d1e2f-e678-463d-b909-640b0b57403b)
comments:
There are 99 tables, and each has 100 columns and 12*28 partitions.
No data in them.
It's confirmed that the pulse is caused by `GCStats`.
